topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 32 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradableproxy, proxy, accesscontrolmixin). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
